WorldDocument.title: WorldDocument
WorldDocument.description: Represents a saved or multiplayer 3D Skyblock world.

name.description: Display name of the Skyblock world.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the world creator.

ownerName.description: Display name of the world owner.

roomCode.description: Short alphanumeric room code for co-building.

isPublic.description: Whether the world allows open co-building via room code.

blocksData.description: Compact serialized representation of placed blocks up to 500KB.

customBlocksData.description: Compact serialized representation of custom block definitions.

blockCount.description: Total number of blocks in the world.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the world was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the world was last updated.

PresenceDocument.title: PresenceDocument
PresenceDocument.description: Tracks a live builder cursor and selection inside a multiplayer world.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the active collaborator.

color.description: Hex color of the collaborator cursor.

cursorX.description: Grid X coordinate of collaborator cursor.

cursorY.description: Grid Y coordinate of collaborator cursor.

cursorZ.description: Grid Z coordinate of collaborator cursor.

isWorldPublic.description: Mirrors parent world public status for list query validation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the cursor update.

BlueprintDocument.title: BlueprintDocument
BlueprintDocument.description: Stores a reusable custom block or multi-block structure blueprint.

name.description: Name of the custom block or structure blueprint.

authorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the blueprint creator.

authorName.description: Display name of the blueprint author.

blueprintType.description: Whether this blueprint is a custom_block or structure_blueprint.

isPublic.description: Whether this blueprint is published to the Community Gallery.

blockCount.description: Number of blocks inside the blueprint.

payload.description: Serialized blueprint definition and relative block positions.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the blueprint was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the blueprint was updated.

/worlds/{worldId}.description: Stores saved and multiplayer Skyblock worlds.

/worlds/{worldId}/presence/{userId}.description: Stores real-time collaborator cursor positions inside a world.

/blueprints/{blueprintId}.description: Stores reusable custom blocks and multi-block structure blueprints.
